migrationNotes: Fifth HHH Core Case release, produced against the released Core Case 04 baseline 661c5c0caad2e6996dff20f86c7565d19116b1ec and the approved Blueprint.

Owner-approved printable baseline: 8bf2d6a299f96228fc0f1bbdb6e50000074e7298. The owner reviewed that byte set on screen through the local Curriculum Editor and printed it at 100% / Actual Size. Release conversion changed no printable source: content.html, presentation.css and layout-overrides.json are byte-identical to that commit, and only task-registry.js moved, to carry the lifecycle stamp, which renders nothing. All 41 pages were re-rendered in colour and grayscale at both trees and all 82 page images are byte-identical.

Certified release-source commit: d2db112745f9867d6f501748b1cab93daf550b92. The released task-registry.js bytes first exist at the release-conversion commit, because the lifecycle stamp is created by release conversion, so the pins identify that commit rather than the owner printable baseline. This was proven by walking every commit in the feature range and testing the full released four-file byte set at each, not assumed. The two are recorded separately and deliberately, following the Case 03 and Case 04 precedent.
No post-review art-direction commits exist for this case. The commit the independent reviewer passed and the commit the owner approved and printed are the same commit.
Frozen game-source baseline: d9fc16baf272cb543c29cbd0c06ec85efad60be8. The Phase 1 audit baseline remains 9b8545ed6ecf98b337326390400076e36789e056.
Runtime case identity: C1 L5, The Dust Bowl, the southern plains and Washington, 1935. instructionalType CORE_CASE.

Nine tasks carry the Core Case spine, and the case's organising idea is interaction: a case with two causes cannot be answered by choosing one of them, and the failure runs in both directions. Task 9 Part D carries transfer rather than a tenth task. All four Blueprint-named families are present: H3 at Task 3, H8 at Task 4, H5 at Task 6 and H11 at Task 7.

Every role carries one four-role causal frame - condition, vulnerability, mechanism, response, plus a modelled feedback - declared in task-registry.js under causalFrame and marked in the markup with data-causal-role, so the audit's requirement that the drought remain a cause is structurally checkable rather than a matter of prose. Task 3 establishes the drought on the instrumental record before land use is mentioned, which is an ordering argument and not an accident.

Canonical CER is deliberately not used. The Blueprint names a qualified multi-causal explanation as this case's product, and a single claim-evidence-reasoning frame would collapse four causal roles and a feedback relation into one claim.

Source model: twelve canonical caseSources entries across four evidentiary statuses - documented (5), modeled (5), reconstructed (1) and debated (1) - including a real historical primary source, the Soil Conservation Act of 27 April 1935, 49 Stat. 163. The Teacher source ledger covers all twelve in nine printed rows under a declared grouping rule, and a parity guard checks ledger coverage against the canonical estate in both directions.

Three things the packet deliberately does not print, because the sources do not support them: an exact date for Bennett's testimony, where published accounts disagree and dust reached Washington more than once that spring; a total for the federal shelterbelt programme, where published totals differ substantially; and any numerical apportionment of the causes, because no source in the packet supplies one, so the causation map assigns no weights.

HHH-GAME-C1L5-001 was RESOLVED_VERIFIED in the game before this package was authored. The curriculum does not merely avoid the corrected wording, it teaches the boundary: Task 4 Part C assesses what the bounded core readings do and do not establish, Task 8 Claim 4 makes the absolute reading a claim to be refused, and the Answer Key and rubric each carry a floor. HHH-GAME-C1L5-002 remains a curriculum qualification and is discharged in five places rather than as a disclaimer.

A residual absolute survives in the game's own Level 5 distractor hint, the phrase dead pale sand. It was classified CURRICULUM_HANDLING_SUFFICIENT by independent review, is reproduced nowhere in this package, and no game edit was made.

Declared Accessible adaptations: exactly four, and no fifth. The Task 5 COVER row is supplied as a worked model so the Accessible learner completes eight cells against ten; two of the eight Task 6 factor cards are pre-placed so six are placed against eight; the Task 7 rail repeats each slot's date; and each Task 8 claim carries a source pointer. The Task 6 feedback relation is printed on the map in both editions and graded in neither, so it is not a difference between them.

Edition parity is enforced structurally rather than in prose. task-registry.js carries an editionResponseContract naming, for all nineteen assessed subparts, the exact response ids each edition collects and which difference class applies - parity, declared reduction registered against one of the four adaptations, chunking with an identical obligation, or accessible-only, which is prohibited. The validator checks live markup against it in both directions, so an Accessible edition cannot acquire a required response the Student edition never asks for.

Regression protection retained by the release: the case-scoped validator carries five bounded semantic contracts - subsoil, drought, land use, policy and source status - each pairing a negative guard over a closed class with a positive structural requirement checked against markup, plus figure-accessibility parity, ledger coverage parity, claim marks checked against the registry, and the edition response contract.

The subsoil zero boundary is the most consequential thing this release carries, and its final shape came from four bounded review rounds. The blocking rule is: a protected subsoil subject together with a declared biological-zero or universal-growth-zero concept fails, unless covered by a registered exemption. The concept classes are marked selfSufficient, because the prohibited predicate is itself the biological claim and requiring a second life token let the strongest violations through. The eighteen declared prohibitedFramings are a diagnostic register reconciled against the enforced classes rather than a second matcher.

A blocking safe-vocabulary gate was retired by PMO decision during review and deliberately deleted rather than demoted. It required truthful prose to contain a listed comparative adjective, and it could not converge: each round found more true sentences it rejected. Safe prose now passes when it carries no prohibited zero concept, and is protected instead by a registry-owned regression corpus of 129 must-fail sentences across eighteen groups and 53 must-pass sentences across six, with no duplicates and no overlap. Twenty-eight of the must-fail sentences pair a zero claim with ordinary safe wording in both clause orders, which is what demonstrates that zero detection and not any vocabulary list carries safety.

The registry is the single authority for this boundary: the protected subject patterns, the concept classes, the corpus and the enforced roles all live in task-registry.js, and the validator holds no private matcher and no private fixtures. Eleven mutation controls prove the guards are load-bearing, including one that reintroduces the retired whitelist and shows it rejecting truthful prose again.

One nonblocking observation is carried forward as future validator maintenance and was deliberately not reopened during release conversion: the universal-growth-zero object class does not cover the noun weed, so a construction such as could never support so much as a weed is not caught. Independent review classified it as an observation rather than a blocker and the PMO ruled against expanding the object class. It affects no released classroom byte.

This release claims no SSS legacy exemption. It is a full current-contract release with frozen Student, Teacher and Answer Key DOM baselines; the Accessible DOM hash was additionally computed and compared at both trees to prove parity across all four roles.
